name: Mindee
label: Mindee V2 inference — extraction models
description: Official Mindee API v2 at https://api-v2.mindee.net. POST /v2/products/extraction/enqueue with JSON {model_id, url|file_base64} (multipart file also official; OfficialApiNode JSON-encodes type file refs). invoice, receipt, and passport are the same enqueue path — pass the UUID of the Invoice / Receipt / Passport model cloned from Mindee's catalog in your account (V2 has no global /invoices/v4 product path). Authorization header is the raw API key (not Bearer, not Token). Identity docs = PII. Docs: https://docs.mindee.com/integrations/api-reference/extraction-models.md.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Enqueue an extraction inference (model_id + url or file), then poll it with job_id (get_job) or fetch it with inference_id (get_result). model_id is the account model UUID. Provide url (HTTPS) or file (platform ref-id). Do not put api_key here. Example: {"model_id":"11111111-2222-4333-8444-555555555555","url":"https://example.com/invoice.pdf"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation. EXACT: predict | invoice | receipt | passport | get_job | get_result. The first four POST the same V2 extraction enqueue (async); the model_id selects Invoice vs Receipt vs Passport vs custom schema. get_job polls job_id; get_result fetches inference_id.

schema.label: model_id
schema.description: Mindee v2 model id for every enqueue. Example: my-invoice-model.

schema.label: file
schema.description: Document file (platform file list) for predict / invoice / receipt / passport.

schema.label: url
schema.description: HTTPS document URL alternative to file.

schema.label: filename
schema.description: Original file name when sending file_base64.

schema.label: raw_text
schema.description: predict: return raw text. Example: true.

schema.label: confidence
schema.description: predict: return confidence scores. Example: true.

schema.label: job_id
schema.description: Job UUID returned by any enqueue operation (response job.id) for operation get_job (GET /v2/jobs/{job_id}). Returns the job status while Processing; once Processed the server redirects and the node returns the extraction result. Example: 12345678-1234-4123-8123-123456789abc.

schema.label: inference_id
schema.description: Inference UUID of a processed job (job.result_url tail or inference.id) for operation get_result (GET /v2/products/extraction/results/{inference_id}). Example: 87654321-4321-4321-8321-cba987654321.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Enqueue returns HTTP 202 with job (id, polling_url, status). OfficialApiNode does not poll. Retrieve via GET job.result_url when Processed. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Designer intent. EXACT: predict | invoice | receipt | passport | get_job | get_result. predict / invoice / receipt / passport POST /v2/products/extraction/enqueue (async, returns job.id); bind the matching catalog model UUID as input.model_id. get_job = GET /v2/jobs/{job_id} (status, or the result once Processed). get_result = GET /v2/products/extraction/results/{inference_id}.

configurationParameters.label: API key
configurationParameters.description: Mindee V2 API key (starts with md_). Authorization header value is the key only — not Bearer and not Token (V1). V1 and V2 keys are not interchangeable. StudioQuack secret. Never logged.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: HTTP timeout for enqueue. Default 60. Floor 1. Inference itself is async (up to 590s server-side).
